newsitem.title: USA: Rexene board sets special meeting April 30.
newsitem.headline: Rexene board sets special meeting April 30.

text.p: The board of Rexene Corp has scheduled a special shareholders' meeting for April 30 after it said a majority of the company's shareholders backed a request by the Wyser-Pratte/Spear Leeds Kellogg group to hold the gathering, the company announced Friday.

The group, which holds a 10.1 percent stake in Rexene, will ask shareholders to elect its four board nominees at the special meeting. Its efforts aim to make the Rexene board reconsider a previously rejected offer by the Huntsman Corp or better bids, to acquire the company.
The Rexene board said shareholders of record on April 18 are entitled to participate in the meeting.
Separately, the Wyser-Pratte/Speer Leeds group, said it notified the company of its plan to nominate six directors to the still unscheduled annual meeting of the company this year.
The slate has two more candidates that what it proposed for the special meeting.

"The only reason our annual meeting slate is six candidates, instead of the four we have nominated for the April 30 meeting is to ensure that we win a majority of the 10-member Rexene board at the annual meeting," it said.

Rexene, a maker of thermoplastics and petrochemicals, rejected a $16-a-share bid from Huntsman in November, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. Huntsman, a chemicals company, said on February 7 it was still interested in acquiring Rexene.

The group said its notification of its candidates for the annual meeting does not affect its efforts to replace the Resene bord at the special meeting. The group previously said that holders of 58 percent of Rexene stock had backed its call for the special meeting.
